---
title: "Visualizing the AI Economy"
---


```{python}
import altair as alt

from altair.datasets import data
```

```{python}
# load a sample dataset as a pandas DataFrame
cars = data.cars()

# make the chart
alt.Chart(cars).mark_point().encode(
    x='Horsepower',
    y='Miles_per_Gallon',
    color='Origin',
).interactive()
```
